title: BioCompute FASTQ QC pipeline parameters
description: Portable FASTQ quality control: per-sample read statistics and an HTML QC report

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Generated automatically by BioCompute from the selected experiment. Columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, condition, replicate.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

qc_options.title: QC thresholds
qc_options.description: Thresholds used to classify reads as passing.

min_read_length.description: Minimum read length for a read to pass.

min_mean_quality.description: Minimum mean Phred quality for a read to pass.

report_title.description: Title shown at the top of the HTML report (no quotes or backslashes).

max_reads.description: Only analyse the first N reads of each file (0 = all reads).
max_reads.help_text: Useful for quick checks of very large runs.
